The uniquely modular approach enables you to cherry-pick the stuff you want and integrate it into your existing architecture or fully integrate your site into phpNova from the ground-up.  The permissive licensing structure is also intended to make this easy for IP-wary companies.  No other PHP framework is designed to offer this level of flexibility and portability.
